name: endnote-analysis
description: Offline EndNote library analysis: topic clustering & evolution, keyword co-occurrence network, reading status, duplicate detection, staleness warnings, robustness and effect-size checks, plus a one-click literature-review skeleton. Read-only, Python-first.

displayDescription.en: Offline analysis of your local EndNote library: topic clustering and evolution, keyword co-occurrence network, reading status, duplicate detection, staleness and robustness checks, then a one-click literature-review skeleton. Strictly read-only, never fabricates references.
displayDescription.zh: 离线分析本地文献库：主题聚类演化、共现网络、阅读状态、重复与时效预警，生成综述骨架。只读不编造。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze my EndNote library and show me the research topics
